BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the implementation of yearround PacificStandard Time; adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and repealingRCW 1.20.051.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The time of the state of Washington shall be Pacific Standard Timethroughout the calendar year, as determined by reference to GreenwichMean Time.
RCW 1.20.051 (Daylight saving time) and 1963c 14 s 1 & 1961 c 3 s 1 are each repealed.
